servers.title: servers
servers.description:
Specifies time (NTP) servers to use for setting the system time.
Defaults to time.cloudflare.com when configuration is not provided.
servers.markdownDescription:
Specifies time (NTP) servers to use for setting the system time.
Defaults to `time.cloudflare.com` when configuration is not provided.
servers.x-intellij-html-description: Specifies time (NTP) servers to use for setting the system time. Defaults to time.cloudflare.com when configuration is not provided.

useNTS.title: useNTS
useNTS.description:
Enables NTS (Network Time Security) for NTP queries.
NTS provides authenticated and encrypted time synchronization using TLS.
When enabled, all NTP capable servers must be specified as hostnames (not IP addresses).
Defaults to true when configuration is not provided, using the system default server (time.cloudflare.com).
useNTS.markdownDescription:
Enables NTS (Network Time Security) for NTP queries.
NTS provides authenticated and encrypted time synchronization using TLS.
When enabled, all NTP capable servers must be specified as hostnames (not IP addresses).
Defaults to `true` when configuration is not provided, using the system default server (`time.cloudflare.com`).
useNTS.x-intellij-html-description: Enables NTS (Network Time Security) for NTP queries. NTS provides authenticated and encrypted time synchronization using TLS. When enabled, all NTP capable servers must be specified as hostnames (not IP addresses). Defaults to true when configuration is not provided, using the system default server (time.cloudflare.com).

devices.title: devices
devices.description:
description: |
    A list of PTP devices to sync with (e.g. provided by the hypervisor).

A PTP device is typically represented as a character device file in the /dev directory,


such as /dev/ptp0 or /dev/ptp_kvm. These devices are used to synchronize the system time
    with an external time source that supports the Precision Time Protocol.

Defaults to true.

bootTimeout.title: bootTimeout
bootTimeout.description:
Specifies the timeout when the node time is considered to be in sync unlocking the boot sequence.
NTP sync will be still running in the background.
Defaults to “infinity” (waiting forever for time sync)
bootTimeout.markdownDescription:
Specifies the timeout when the node time is considered to be in sync unlocking the boot sequence.
NTP sync will be still running in the background.
Defaults to "infinity" (waiting forever for time sync)
bootTimeout.x-intellij-html-description: Specifies the timeout when the node time is considered to be in sync unlocking the boot sequence. NTP sync will be still running in the background. Defaults to “infinity” (waiting forever for time sync)
